messages.text:
Hi! Here’s where each order stands:

- **Wicker storage basket:** I’m sorry, but its refund deadline was **11 November 2026**, and no earlier on-time request exists, so it cannot be refunded. (refund-policy/v2/window)
- **Linen laundry liner:** It must arrive back at the shop before a refund can be requested. Its request deadline is **5 December 2026**; mailing it alone does not count as a refund request. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
- **Cedar coat hangers:** Since the order is marked delivered but you haven’t received it, **a staff member will take over** to investigate the missing package. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)
